name: Top Class Education For Scheduled Caste Students
nodalDept: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
briefDescription: Top Class Education for SC Students covers full tuition fees (up to ₹2 lakh/year at private institutions) plus an academic allowance of ₹2,220/month for SC students who have secured admission to one of the government's notified premier institutions.
descriptionMd:
Top Class Education for Scheduled Caste Students, administered by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MoSJ&E), supports meritorious SC students who make it into some of India's best institutions — IITs, NITs, medical colleges, law schools, management schools and other notified institutes. Because fees at these institutions are often beyond a poor family's reach, the scheme removes the financial barrier entirely for qualifying SC scholars.

The scholarship is disbursed through the **National Scholarships Portal (NSP)** and is renewed annually based on satisfactory academic progress.
benefitsMd:
- **Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges** paid by the government.
  - For private-sector notified institutions: subject to a ceiling of **₹2,00,000 per annum**.
  - For government institutions: actual fees paid.
- **Academic Allowance:** ₹2,220 per month for books, stationery and computer expenses.
- **Living Expenses:** ₹3,000 per month for hostellers (non-residential students use Day Scholar rate).
- **Insurance:** covered under PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana.
eligibilityMd:
- Must belong to the **Scheduled Caste (SC)** category with a valid caste certificate.
- Must have secured **admission to a notified institution** identified under the scheme (the institution must be on the approved list available on the NSP).
- Must be pursuing a **graduate, postgraduate, or doctoral degree** beyond Class 12.
- Annual **family income must not exceed ₹6 lakh**.
- The scheme is not available to students already receiving another full-fee scholarship or comparable government support.
exclusionsMd:
- Students at **non-notified institutions** are not eligible — verify your institution is on the NSP approved list before applying.
- Students whose family income exceeds ₹6 lakh are excluded.
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Visit [scholarships.gov.in](https://scholarships.gov.in/) and click **'New Registration'**.
**Step 2:** Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) — mobile, Aadhaar, email and bank details.
**Step 3:** Log in and select **'Top Class Education for SC Students'** under Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.
**Step 4:** Fill in the application — institution name, course, admission date, SC certificate details, family income.
**Step 5:** Upload documents: SC certificate, Class 12 marksheet, admission letter, fee receipt, income certificate, Aadhaar, bank passbook.
**Step 6:** Submit before the annual deadline. Your institution verifies the application and forwards it for approval and disbursement.
